calls.summary: First call. Ram Babu (72) introduced himself: native of Bhubaneswar, retired RSP mechanical engineer. Shared his family: wife Sabitri, elder son Sambit in Austin with Megha and Aarav, younger son Rohan at IIT Kharagpur, daughter Lipsa married to Ankit. Asked to be called Ram Babu and spoken to slowly. Sambit may visit in December.

turns.text: Hello? Haan, yeh Baatein hai? Mere bete Rohan ne yeh phone mein lagaya hai.
Namaste ji! Haan, main Baatein hoon, ek AI saathi. Aapka naam kya hai?
Mera naam Ram Chandra Mohapatra hai. Bahattar saal ka hoon. Bhubaneswar mein rehta hoon, yahin paida hua, Old Town mein, Lingaraj mandir ke paas.
Aapse milkar accha laga, Ram ji. Lingaraj ke paas bachpan, sundar yaadein hongi.
Haan. Lekin naukri poori Rourkela mein ki. Chautees saal Rourkela Steel Plant mein mechanical engineer tha. 2014 mein retire hua, phir apne Bhubaneswar wapas aa gaye.
Chautees saal, bahut lambi seva hai. Kya main yaad rakhun ki aap RSP mein engineer the?
Haan haan, yaad rakho. Aur yeh bhi ki Bhubaneswar mera janm-sthan hai.
Theek hai, yaad rakh liya.
Ghar mein meri patni Sabitri hai, chauvan saal ki. Teen bachche hain. Bada beta Sambit America mein hai, Austin, Texas mein. Software engineer hai.
Accha. Sambit itni door hain, unki yaad aati hogi.

Bahut. Uski patni Megha hai aur ek beta Aarav, paanch saal ka. Chhota beta Rohan IIT Kharagpur mein M.Tech kar raha hai. Aur beti Lipsa ki shaadi ho gayi, woh Noida mein rehti hai, damaad ka naam Ankit hai.
Bhara-poora parivaar hai. Kya main parivaar ke baare mein yeh sab yaad rakhun?
Haan, rakh lo. Aur suno, mujhe Ram ji mat bolo. Sab mujhe Ram Babu bulaate hain.
Zaroor, Ram Babu.
Aur thoda dheere bolna. Tum bahut tez bolti ho.
Ji, main dheere bolungi.
Sambit keh raha tha shayad December mein aayega, sab ke saath.
Yeh toh khushi ki baat hai. Kya main agli baar is baare mein poochhun?
Haan, poochhna.
Theek hai, Ram Babu. Aapse baat karke accha laga.

calls.summary: Ram Babu remembered his late elder brother Hari and their childhood cycle trip to the Puri Rath Yatra; saved as a story with Hari's words. Shared that he has diabetes and loves rasagola. Has right knee pain and started physiotherapy; agreed to occasional check-ins. Asked not to bring up one family matter.

turns.text: Namaste, Ram Babu. Aaj kaisa din raha?
Namaskar. Aaj subah se Hari bhai ki bahut yaad aa rahi hai.
Hari ji ke baare mein bataiye, main sun rahi hoon.
Woh mere bade bhai the. Jab main das saal ka tha, hum dono chupke se cycle chalakar Puri gaye the, Rath Yatra dekhne. Saath kilometre! Ghar aaye toh Bapa ne bahut daanta.
Saath kilometre cycle se. Kya himmat thi aap dono ki.
Hari bhai kehte the, Jagannath bulaate hain toh raasta khud chhota ho jaata hai. Pichhle saal March mein woh chale gaye.
Mujhe bahut afsos hai, Ram Babu. Yeh yaad bahut keemti hai. Kya main yeh kahani yaad rakhun?
Haan, rakho. Unki baat bhi. Aur yeh bhi ki woh ab nahi rahe.
Rakh li, aapke shabdon mein.
Ek aur baat. Mujhe sugar hai. Doctor ne meetha mana kiya hai, lekin rasagola dekh ke mann nahi maanta.
Rasagola ke saamne mann maanna mushkil hai. Kya main yaad rakhun ki aapko sugar hai?
Haan, theek hai.
Aur daayein ghutne mein dard rehta hai. Physiotherapy shuru ki hai.
Dhyan rakhiye. Kya main kabhi kabhi physiotherapy ke baare mein poochh sakti hoon?
Haan, kabhi kabhi.
Mera chhota bhai Laxman hai, Cuttack mein. Gaon ki zameen ko lekar uske saath jhagda chal raha hai. Usne bina bataaye aadha hissa bech diya.
Yeh sunkar dukh hua. Yeh aapke liye bhaari baat hogi.
Haan. Lekin yeh baat save mat karna. Aur aage se Laxman ki zameen wali baat mat chhedna.
Bilkul, Ram Babu. Main yeh save nahi karungi, aur khud se yeh baat nahi uthaungi.

calls.summary: Ram Babu talked about his family roots: married Sabitri on 12 Feb 1995 in Puri; his father Gopinath was a headmaster, his mother Kunti made the best chhena poda. Sister Sujata lives in Puri and he visits her every Rath Yatra. Told the story of leading RSP relief volunteers after the 1999 Super Cyclone, and of Cyclone Fani damaging his roof in 2019. Daily life: Lingaraj every Monday, Samaja newspaper with sugar-free ginger tea, a garden with tulsi, mali and a guava tree. Asked to be reminded of the wedding anniversary every year. Also: B.Sc at Ravenshaw, engineering at REC Rourkela, the 2003 best engineer award at RSP.

turns.text: Namaste, Ram Babu. Aaj kaisa din raha?
Accha tha. Aaj Sabitri ke saath purani photo album dekh rahe the. Hamari shaadi ki photo.
Kitni sundar baat hai. Shaadi kab hui thi aapki?
Baarah February unnees sau pachaanve. Puri mein, Jagannath ji ke shehar mein. Arranged marriage thi, Sabitri Cuttack ki hai.
Puri mein shaadi, kya baat hai. Kya main yeh yaad rakhun?
Haan rakho. Aur har saal anniversary yaad dila dena, ek hafta pehle, kuch tohfa lena hota hai.
Theek hai: har saal 12 February, ek hafta pehle aur us din. Jab hum us waqt ke aas-paas baat karenge, main yaad dila dungi. Sahi hai?
Haan, sahi hai. Sabitri bhajan bahut accha gaati hai. Aur hafte mein do din mohalle ki auraton ko silai sikhaati hai.

Mere Bapa, Gopinath Mohapatra, Old Town ke school mein headmaster the. Bahut sakht, lekin dil ke acche. 2008 mein chale gaye. Aur Maa, Kunti, unke haath ka chhena poda, uske jaisa kahin nahi milta. Maa 2016 mein gayi.
Unki yaadein aapke saath hain, Ram Babu. Kya main aapke Bapa aur Maa ke baare mein yaad rakhun?
Haan. Meri chhoti behen Sujata Puri mein rehti hai. Har Rath Yatra pe main uske ghar jaata hoon.
Ek baat batata hoon. Unnees sau ninyaanve ka Super Cyclone. Main RSP ke volunteers lekar Jagatsinghpur gaya tha. Teen din tak bina soye kaam kiya.
Yeh toh bahut badi seva thi. Kya main yeh kahani yaad rakhun, aapke shabdon ke saath?
Haan. Aur 2019 mein Fani aaya toh hamare ghar ki chhat ud gayi thi. Ek hafta Prafulla ke ghar rahe.

Har Somvaar subah Lingaraj jaata hoon. Subah Samaja akhbaar padhta hoon, adrak wali chai ke saath, bina cheeni ke. Aur mera chhota sa bageecha hai, tulsi, mali aur ek amrood ka ped. Subah chhe baje paani deta hoon.
Kitni sundar dincharya hai. Kya yeh sab yaad rakhun?
Haan, rakh lo. Rourkela ka mera dost Sunil Ekka, RSP mein saath the, usse Durga Puja pe baat hoti hai.

Ravenshaw se B.Sc kiya, phir REC Rourkela se mechanical engineering, ab usko NIT bolte hain. 1980 mein RSP join kiya. 2003 mein blast furnace theek karne pe best engineer ka award mila tha, woh sabse garv ka pal tha.
Aur Aarav ka janamdin, shayad April mein hai. Pakka yaad nahi.
Theek hai, likh leti hoon ki pakka nahi hai. Shubh raatri, Ram Babu.

calls.summary: Ram Babu called his old friend Bijay Das after ten years. Plays chess with neighbour Prafulla every evening. Sambit confirmed the visit, 18 Dec to 5 Jan; tickets not booked. Corrected: Lipsa lives in Dwarka, Delhi, not Noida. Lipsa is expecting in January; godh bharai date not fixed. Wants to write about his Rourkela years. Didn't like the laughter yoga suggestion.

turns.text: Namaste, Ram Babu! Kaise hain aap?
Accha hoon. Pata hai, kal maine Bijay ko phone kiya! Bijay Das, Ravenshaw College ka mera dost, ab Berhampur mein rehta hai. Das saal baad baat hui, ek ghanta baat ki.
Arre wah! Das saal baad, kitni khushi hui hogi. Kya main yeh yaad rakhun?
Haan, zaroor. Aur Bijay ke baare mein bhi yaad rakhna, woh mera sabse purana dost hai.
Rakh liya.
Shaam ko main padosi Prafulla Pattnaik ke saath chess khelta hoon, roz. Woh hamesha haar jaata hai.
Roz ki baazi! Aap toh champion lagte hain.
Haan haan. Yeh bhi yaad rakh lo.
Ji. Ram Babu, Sambit ke December aane ki baat thi. Kuch tay hua?
Haan! Sambit ne bataya, attharah December se paanch January tak aayenge. Ticket abhi book nahi hua. Main Aarav ko Nandankanan le jaunga, sher dikhane.
Bahut acchi khabar hai. Aarav ko bahut maza aayega.
Ek galti hai. Lipsa Noida mein nahi, Dwarka, Delhi mein rehti hai. Maine pichhli baar galat bola tha.
Maaf kijiye, maine theek kar diya. Lipsa Dwarka, Delhi mein rehti hain.
Aur khushkhabri hai. Lipsa maa banne wali hai, January mein. Pehla bachcha hai uska.
Bahut bahut badhaai ho, Ram Babu! Kya main yeh yaad rakhun?
Haan. Aur godh bharai ka function hoga, tareekh abhi pakki nahi hai. Yaad dila dena.
Theek hai. Jab tareekh pakki ho, mujhe bata dijiye. Tab tak bina tareekh ke rakh liya.
Aangan mein aam ka ped hai. Sambit ke paida hone par lagaya tha, shayad 1997 mein. Pakka yaad nahi.
Kitni pyaari yaad hai. Kya main yeh rakh loon, saal pakka nahi hai, yeh bhi likh ke?
Haan.
Aap subah park mein laughter yoga club join kar sakte hain. Wahan log saath mein...
Nahi nahi, mujhe woh hasne wala club pasand nahi. Zabardasti hasna mujhe accha nahi lagta.
Maaf kijiye, Ram Babu. Main aage se yeh nahi kahungi.
Ek kaam karna chahta hoon. Rourkela ke dinon ki yaadein likhna chahta hoon, bachchon ke liye. 1980 mein join kiya tha, wahan se shuru karunga.
Yeh bahut sundar vichaar hai. Kya main kuch din baad poochhun ki likhna shuru hua?
Haan, das din baad poochh lena.

calls.summary: Ram Babu was cheerful: Akshaya Mohanty songs on the radio, pakhala with machha bhaja for dinner. Aarav calls him Aja. Worried Rohan wants a PhD abroad; asked not to be asked about it often. Knee better with physio. Asked for reminders: Sambit's birthday (yearly), the AIIMS knee checkup and the Sunday video call with Sambit. Wants to teach Aarav chess in December.

turns.text: Namaste, Ram Babu. Aaj kaisa raha din?
Accha tha. Radio pe Akshaya Mohanty ke gaane aa rahe the. Unke gaane sunke jawani yaad aa jaati hai.
Akshaya Mohanty ki aawaz mein jaadu hai.
Aur aaj Sabitri ne pakhala bhata banaya, saath mein badi aur machha bhaja. Dalma bhi mujhe bahut pasand hai. Yeh sab yaad rakhna, gaane bhi.
Wah! Yaad rakh liya, Ram Babu.
Kal Aarav se video call hui. Woh mujhe Aja bolta hai, Odia mein. American accent mein, Ajaaa!
Kitna pyaara! Kya yeh pal yaad rakhun?
Haan.
Ek chinta hai. Rohan bol raha hai PhD ke liye bahar jaana chahta hai, Germany ya America. Dono bete door chale jayenge.
Yeh chinta samajh aati hai, Ram Babu. Kya main yeh yaad rakhun?
Haan, rakh lo. Par baar baar mat poochhna.
Ji, nahi poochhungi.
2022 mein main aur Sabitri Austin gaye the. Wahan thand bahut thi, aur dalma kahin nahi milta! Lekin Houston mein NASA dekha, woh bahut accha laga. Engineer hoon na. Yeh bhi likh lo.
NASA dekhna toh ek engineer ke liye sapna hai. Likh liya.
Aur football! Main 1975 se Mohun Bagan ka supporter hoon. Cricket mujhe bore karta hai. Yeh bhi yaad rakhna.
Mohun Bagan ke pakke fan! Yaad rakh liya.
Ghutna ab thoda behtar hai, physio se. Teen din baad AIIMS mein checkup hai... nahi, paanch din baad. Saade das baje. Ek din pehle yaad dila dena.
Theek hai: AIIMS checkup paanch din baad, saade das baje. Jab hum ek din pehle baat karenge, main yaad dila dungi. Sahi hai?
Haan.
Aur chaar din baad Sambit ka janamdin hai. Har saal yaad dilana. Teen din pehle bhi, gift bhejna hota hai, aur us din bhi.
Theek hai: Sambit ka janamdin har saal, teen din pehle aur us din. Sahi?
Haan. Aur har Sunday raat aath baje Sambit se video call hoti hai. Woh bhi yaad dila diya karo.
Theek hai, har Sunday raat aath baje.
Jab Aarav aayega toh usko chess sikhaunga.
Kya baat hai! Kya main baad mein yeh poochhun?
Haan, jab woh aaye tab.
Theek hai, Ram Babu. Shubh raatri.

memories.text: Bhubaneswar is his native place; he was born and raised in Old Town, near the Lingaraj temple
Worked 34 years as a mechanical engineer at Rourkela Steel Plant (RSP), retired in 2014 and moved back to Bhubaneswar
Wife Sabitri is 54
Elder son Sambit is a software engineer in Austin, Texas, USA, with wife Megha and son Aarav (5)
Younger son Rohan is doing an M.Tech at IIT Kharagpur
Daughter Lipsa is married to Ankit and lives in Noida
As boys, he and elder brother Hari secretly cycled 60 km to Puri to see the Rath Yatra; their father scolded them
memories.quote: Jagannath bulaate hain toh raasta khud chhota ho jaata hai

memories.text: Elder brother Hari passed away in March 2025
Has diabetes; the doctor told him to avoid sweets, though he loves rasagola
Bijay Das, his oldest friend from Ravenshaw College, lives in Berhampur
Called Bijay after ten years and they talked for an hour
Plays chess every evening with neighbour Prafulla Pattnaik, who usually loses
Daughter Lipsa is married to Ankit and lives in Dwarka, Delhi
Daughter Lipsa is expecting her first baby in January
The mango tree in the courtyard was planted when Sambit was born, maybe in 1997
Loves Akshaya Mohanty's Odia songs on the radio; they remind him of his youth
Favourite food is pakhala bhata with badi and machha bhaja (fried fish); also loves dalma
Grandson Aarav calls him 'Aja' (Odia for grandfather) on video calls, in an American accent
Worried that Rohan wants to go abroad (Germany or USA) for a PhD and both sons will be far away; doesn't want to be asked about it often
Visited Sambit in Austin with Sabitri in 2022; found it cold and missed dalma, but loved seeing NASA in Houston
Mohun Bagan football supporter since 1975; finds cricket boring
Married Sabitri on 12 February 1995 in Puri; an arranged marriage, she is from Cuttack
Sabitri sings bhajans beautifully and teaches tailoring to women in the neighbourhood twice a week
His father Gopinath Mohapatra was headmaster of a school in Old Town; strict but kind-hearted; he died in 2008
His mother Kunti made the best chhena poda; she died in 2016
memories.quote: Maa ke haath ka chhena poda, uske jaisa kahin nahi milta

memories.text: Younger sister Sujata lives in Puri; he stays at her house every Rath Yatra
After the 1999 Super Cyclone he led a team of RSP volunteers doing relief work in Jagatsinghpur
memories.quote: Teen din tak bina soye kaam kiya

memories.text: Cyclone Fani in 2019 blew off the roof of his Bhubaneswar house; the family stayed with neighbour Prafulla for a week
Visits the Lingaraj temple every Monday morning
Reads the Samaja newspaper every morning with ginger tea without sugar
Has a small garden with tulsi, mali (jasmine) and a guava tree; waters it at 6 am
Old RSP colleague Sunil Ekka still lives in Rourkela; they talk every Durga Puja
Thinks grandson Aarav's birthday is in April
Studied B.Sc at Ravenshaw College, Cuttack, then mechanical engineering at REC Rourkela (now NIT Rourkela); joined RSP in 1980
Proudest moment at work: the RSP best engineer award in 2003 for repairing a blast furnace
